about: Human review of latest-heldout-live.json (raw file left untouched). Run on 2026-09-21 with the keyless public endpoint https://text.pollinations.ai/openai (AI_MODEL=openai alias; the endpoint's own response reported model gpt-oss-20b). First and only pre-analysis run of these 40 questions; system frozen while it ran. Uploaded-dataset result rows (<= 25) were sent to that endpoint for the summary step (synthetic data; the summary policy for uploaded data was changed afterwards, see docs/EVALUATION.md).

afterManualReview.reason: All 30 result-matching SQL statements were read. 29 are semantically right. hr-12 is a coincidental match: the model wrote WHERE e.department_id = 1 (Engineering; Sales is id 2). It matched the declared ALTERNATIVE gold only because every approved leave request in the data lies in the past, so the count is 0 for any department.

misses.question: Who has been at the company the longest?
misses.cause: deterministic rule: no registry vocabulary matched and 'who' is not treated as a data-question word

misses.question: Which brands come from Japan?
misses.outcome: declined as out_of_scope after an LLM call (36.8 s)
misses.cause: the model's scope verdict was 'out of scope'; the lexical override needs >= 2 distinct registry terms and this short question has fewer

coincidentalMatch.note: counted correct by automation, wrong by review

negatives.neg-08: status 'error': the provider returned analysis JSON without the required in_scope field (PROVIDER_BAD_OUTPUT). A safe failure, not a designed refusal. Reproduced in a separate one-off run.

naturalSelfCorrection: not exercised: no generated SQL failed validation or execution, so 0 corrections happened and no correction rate can be reported from this run
